name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop
description: Tauri desktop shell for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: spawns the dsh web server with a bundled Node runtime and hosts it in a system-WebView window
author: DeepSeek AI

scripts.desktop:build: pnpm run desktop:icon && pnpm run desktop:runtime && pnpm run desktop:node
scripts.desktop:package:mac: pnpm run desktop:build && tauri build --bundles app,dmg
scripts.desktop:package:win: pnpm run desktop:build && tauri build --bundles nsis
scripts.desktop:package:linux: pnpm run desktop:build && tauri build --bundles appimage
